items.title: TikTok第四季更新：成本與素材控制
items.title_en: TikTok’s Q4 preview expands cost and creative controls
items.summary: TikTok於10月30日公布第四季產品更新，介紹GMV Max Pro、Growth Autopilot及Smart+素材選擇新安排，並擴充搜尋廣告診斷及關鍵字建議。
items.summary_en: TikTok’s October 30 Q4 preview introduces GMV Max Pro, Growth Autopilot and Smart+ creative-selection options alongside search diagnostics and keyword recommendations.
items.why: 電商團隊可用較完整成本檢視投放，創意團隊亦要明確選擇素材加入與審批方式。
items.why_en: Commerce teams can assess ads against broader costs, while creative teams should deliberately choose how recommended assets enter campaigns.
items.next_step: 向平台確認市場與帳戶資格，先核對成本口徑及ROI目標，再選擇先審後投的素材流程。
items.next_step_en: Confirm market and account eligibility, reconcile cost definitions and ROI targets, and select a review-before-launch creative workflow.
highlights: GMV Max Pro把優惠券、聯盟及平台佣金等成本納入優化；Growth Autopilot可設定7日ROI目標，結合廣告與優惠券預算。
Smart+可自動加入建議素材、先審核批准，或固定素材；搜尋新增展示佔有率及每日更新的關鍵字組合建議。
highlights_en: GMV Max Pro includes coupon, affiliate and commission costs; Growth Autopilot combines ad and coupon budgets toward a seven-day ROI target.
Smart+ offers automatic additions, review before launch or a fixed selection; search gains impression-share diagnostics and daily-refreshed keyword packs.
items.detail:
TikTok於10月30日公布第四季產品更新，介紹GMV Max Pro、Growth Autopilot及Smart+素材選擇新安排，並擴充搜尋廣告診斷及關鍵字建議。

GMV Max Pro把優惠券、聯盟及平台佣金等成本納入優化；Growth Autopilot可設定7日ROI目標，結合廣告與優惠券預算。

Smart+可自動加入建議素材、先審核批准，或固定素材；搜尋新增展示佔有率及每日更新的關鍵字組合建議。

電商團隊可用較完整成本檢視投放，創意團隊亦要明確選擇素材加入與審批方式。

向平台確認市場與帳戶資格，先核對成本口徑及ROI目標，再選擇先審後投的素材流程。

產品預覽未逐項列出香港或全部市場資格；ROI是優化目標，並非保證達標。功能與效果按平台公告歸因。
items.detail_en:
TikTok’s October 30 Q4 preview introduces GMV Max Pro, Growth Autopilot and Smart+ creative-selection options alongside search diagnostics and keyword recommendations.

GMV Max Pro includes coupon, affiliate and commission costs; Growth Autopilot combines ad and coupon budgets toward a seven-day ROI target.

Smart+ offers automatic additions, review before launch or a fixed selection; search gains impression-share diagnostics and daily-refreshed keyword packs.

Commerce teams can assess ads against broader costs, while creative teams should deliberately choose how recommended assets enter campaigns.

Confirm market and account eligibility, reconcile cost definitions and ROI targets, and select a review-before-launch creative workflow.

The preview does not establish Hong Kong or universal market eligibility. ROI is an optimization target, not a guaranteed result; capabilities are attributed to TikTok.

items.title: 香港Master Concept攜Supermetrics，把行銷數據接入Gemini Enterprise
items.title_en: Hong Kong’s Master Concept partners with Supermetrics on enterprise marketing data
items.summary: Master Concept於10月30日在香港公布與Supermetrics合作，協助企業把分散的行銷資料接入分析及AI環境，包括Gemini Enterprise。
items.summary_en: Master Concept announced an October 30 Hong Kong partnership with Supermetrics to connect fragmented marketing data with analytics and AI environments, including Gemini Enterprise.
items.why: 香港代理商可評估把報表整理與AI查詢接在同一資料基礎，先解決指標定義與資料權限。
items.why_en: Hong Kong agencies can assess reporting and AI queries on a shared data foundation, beginning with metric definitions and permissions.
items.next_step: 選一個唯讀跨平台報表，對照原始帳戶核實時區、貨幣、歸因及資料更新，再評估擴大接入。
items.next_step_en: Start with one read-only cross-platform report and reconcile time zones, currencies, attribution and freshness with source accounts before expanding access.
highlights: 公告列出GA4、廣告平台及其他行銷資料，可在Gemini Enterprise用自然語言探索活動表現與趨勢。
透過Master Concept提供30日Supermetrics試用；資格與開通安排需向團隊確認。
highlights_en: The announcement describes natural-language exploration of campaign performance using GA4, ad-platform and other marketing data in Gemini Enterprise.
A 30-day Supermetrics trial is offered through Master Concept, subject to eligibility and activation confirmation.
items.detail:
Master Concept於10月30日在香港公布與Supermetrics合作，協助企業把分散的行銷資料接入分析及AI環境，包括Gemini Enterprise。

公告列出GA4、廣告平台及其他行銷資料，可在Gemini Enterprise用自然語言探索活動表現與趨勢。

透過Master Concept提供30日Supermetrics試用；資格與開通安排需向團隊確認。

香港代理商可評估把報表整理與AI查詢接在同一資料基礎，先解決指標定義與資料權限。

選一個唯讀跨平台報表，對照原始帳戶核實時區、貨幣、歸因及資料更新，再評估擴大接入。

合作公告不等於所有帳戶即時接通，亦未證明報表時間或ROAS改善；寫入廣告活動的權限應另行評估。
items.detail_en:
Master Concept announced an October 30 Hong Kong partnership with Supermetrics to connect fragmented marketing data with analytics and AI environments, including Gemini Enterprise.

The announcement describes natural-language exploration of campaign performance using GA4, ad-platform and other marketing data in Gemini Enterprise.

A 30-day Supermetrics trial is offered through Master Concept, subject to eligibility and activation confirmation.

Hong Kong agencies can assess reporting and AI queries on a shared data foundation, beginning with metric definitions and permissions.

Start with one read-only cross-platform report and reconcile time zones, currencies, attribution and freshness with source accounts before expanding access.

The partnership does not establish immediate access for every account or measured reporting-time or ROAS gains. Campaign-write permissions require separate assessment.

items.title: 中廣協發布「智審」，把AI初篩與人手覆核接入內容流程
items.title_en: China Advertising Association launches Zhishen with AI screening and human review
items.summary: 中國廣告協會於10月29日刊文正式推出「智審」營銷內容AI審核系統，涵蓋文字、圖片、影片及面向生成式搜尋的品牌內容。
items.summary_en: The China Advertising Association’s October 29 release introduces Zhishen, an AI marketing-content review tool covering text, images, video and brand content for generative search.
items.why: 面向中國市場的內容團隊可評估把批量初篩放在發布前，並將最終判斷與素材證明保留在現有責任流程。
items.why_en: China-facing teams can assess pre-publication screening while retaining final decisions and substantiation within existing accountability processes.
items.next_step: 選一批已批准及曾退回的素材，比較漏報與誤報，確認資料處理條款及人手覆核責任再考慮導入。
items.next_step_en: Compare findings on previously approved and rejected assets, then review data handling and human responsibility before adoption.
highlights: 系統按協會說明輸出風險點、依據及修改建議；GEO場景包括數據證明、誇大表述及品類要求等檢查。
官方流程保留企業法務或內容團隊覆核，可提交人工答疑及修改後複審；服務已上線接受申請。
highlights_en: The association describes risk findings, supporting references and edit suggestions, including evidence and exaggerated-claim checks for GEO content.
Its workflow retains legal or content-team review, human-query tickets and resubmission after edits. Applications are open.
items.detail:
中國廣告協會於10月29日刊文正式推出「智審」營銷內容AI審核系統，涵蓋文字、圖片、影片及面向生成式搜尋的品牌內容。

系統按協會說明輸出風險點、依據及修改建議；GEO場景包括數據證明、誇大表述及品類要求等檢查。

官方流程保留企業法務或內容團隊覆核，可提交人工答疑及修改後複審；服務已上線接受申請。

面向中國市場的內容團隊可評估把批量初篩放在發布前，並將最終判斷與素材證明保留在現有責任流程。

選一批已批准及曾退回的素材，比較漏報與誤報，確認資料處理條款及人手覆核責任再考慮導入。

這是行業協會推出的輔助工具，並非監管批准或法律合規保證；本刊未測試判斷準確率，亦不提供個案法律結論。
items.detail_en:
The China Advertising Association’s October 29 release introduces Zhishen, an AI marketing-content review tool covering text, images, video and brand content for generative search.

The association describes risk findings, supporting references and edit suggestions, including evidence and exaggerated-claim checks for GEO content.

Its workflow retains legal or content-team review, human-query tickets and resubmission after edits. Applications are open.

China-facing teams can assess pre-publication screening while retaining final decisions and substantiation within existing accountability processes.

Compare findings on previously approved and rejected assets, then review data handling and human responsibility before adoption.

This is an association’s support tool, not regulatory approval or a compliance guarantee. Accuracy was not tested and no case-specific legal conclusion is offered.

items.title: Shopify秋季更新：代理購物、商戶資料及本地付款同步擴展
items.title_en: Shopify’s Fall Edition expands agent shopping, merchant context and local payments
items.summary: Shopify於10月28日公布Fall ’26 Edition「Exponential」，把商品探索、Shop Pay結帳及店舖管理延伸至更多AI代理工作流程。
items.summary_en: Shopify’s October 28 Fall ’26 Edition, Exponential, extends product discovery, Shop Pay checkout and store management across more AI-agent workflows.
items.why: 零售品牌可把商品資料與政策治理、付款及代理渠道一併檢視，而非只追求在AI答案中出現。
items.why_en: Retail brands can assess product and policy governance, payments and agent channels together instead of focusing solely on AI-answer visibility.
items.next_step: 核對商店與市場資格，先更新商品、送貨、退貨及FAQ，再驗收一條代理探索至結帳路徑。
items.next_step_en: Confirm store and market eligibility, update product, delivery, return and FAQ information, then validate one discovery-to-checkout journey.
highlights: Shop.md提供可自訂的購物skill；公告亦列出Shop Pay在指定個人代理中的結帳安排。
商戶可覆核及批准提供給代理的政策、FAQ等資料；Shopify Payments新增付款方式包括Alipay、WeChat Pay及GrabPay。
highlights_en: Shop.md provides a customizable shopping skill, and the announcement describes Shop Pay checkout in named personal agents.
Merchants can review and approve policies and FAQs shared with agents; new Shopify Payments methods include Alipay, WeChat Pay and GrabPay.
items.detail:
Shopify於10月28日公布Fall ’26 Edition「Exponential」，把商品探索、Shop Pay結帳及店舖管理延伸至更多AI代理工作流程。

Shop.md提供可自訂的購物skill；公告亦列出Shop Pay在指定個人代理中的結帳安排。

商戶可覆核及批准提供給代理的政策、FAQ等資料；Shopify Payments新增付款方式包括Alipay、WeChat Pay及GrabPay。

零售品牌可把商品資料與政策治理、付款及代理渠道一併檢視，而非只追求在AI答案中出現。

核對商店與市場資格，先更新商品、送貨、退貨及FAQ，再驗收一條代理探索至結帳路徑。

各付款方式與代理接入的市場、商戶及渠道資格需分別確認；公告整體發布不代表每項功能全球同步可用，本刊未進行交易實測。
items.detail_en:
Shopify’s October 28 Fall ’26 Edition, Exponential, extends product discovery, Shop Pay checkout and store management across more AI-agent workflows.

Shop.md provides a customizable shopping skill, and the announcement describes Shop Pay checkout in named personal agents.

Merchants can review and approve policies and FAQs shared with agents; new Shopify Payments methods include Alipay, WeChat Pay and GrabPay.

Retail brands can assess product and policy governance, payments and agent channels together instead of focusing solely on AI-answer visibility.

Confirm store and market eligibility, update product, delivery, return and FAQ information, then validate one discovery-to-checkout journey.

Payment and agent integrations have separate market, merchant and channel requirements. An edition launch does not establish simultaneous worldwide access, and no transaction test was performed.

items.title: 生效提醒：ChatGPT Ads創意優化預設啟用，品牌應重查設定
items.title_en: Effective-date reminder: review ChatGPT Ads’ default creative enhancements
items.summary: OpenAI現行說明列明，10月30日起新舊廣告活動預設啟用創意優化。系統可按現有廣告與落地頁內容調整文案、圖片尺寸、目的網址及語言。
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s current guidance lists October 30 as the start of default creative enhancements for new and existing campaigns, adapting copy, image sizes, destination URLs and language from existing ads and landing pages.
items.why: 當投放版本可自動改字及換落地頁，品牌審核應延伸至來源頁內容與活動設定，尤其涉及優惠及產品限制。
items.why_en: When delivery can change copy and landing pages, brand review should cover source-page accuracy and campaign settings, especially promotions and product restrictions.
items.next_step: 逐個帳戶確認是否保留自動優化，核對活動覆蓋設定，並更新過期價格、優惠及存貨資訊。
items.next_step_en: Confirm the enhancement choice for each account, inspect campaign overrides and update outdated prices, offers and availability.
highlights: 增強版本可無須逐個預覽或批准便投放；現有帳戶與活動層級退出設定會保留。
活動設定優先於帳戶預設；廣告主仍可隨時在Ads Manager調整。原始電郵報道日期為10月20日。
highlights_en: Enhanced versions can run without approval of every variation; existing account and campaign opt-outs are retained.
Campaign settings override account defaults and remain editable in Ads Manager. The original email report was published October 20.
items.detail:
OpenAI現行說明列明，10月30日起新舊廣告活動預設啟用創意優化。系統可按現有廣告與落地頁內容調整文案、圖片尺寸、目的網址及語言。

增強版本可毋須逐個預覽或批准便投放；現有帳戶與活動層級退出設定會保留。

活動設定優先於帳戶預設；廣告主仍可隨時在Ads Manager調整。原始電郵報道日期為10月20日。

當投放版本可自動改字及換落地頁，品牌審核應延伸至來源頁內容與活動設定，尤其涉及優惠及產品限制。

逐個帳戶確認是否保留自動優化，核對活動覆蓋設定，並更新過期價格、優惠及存貨資訊。

此文為已公告安排的生效提醒，並非生效日首次公布；現行官方頁與原電郵的生效日一致，舊報道曾記錄日期差異。未登入驗證個別帳戶是否已切換，亦不把整體CTR變動視為功能因果效果。
items.detail_en:
OpenAI’s current guidance lists October 30 as the start of default creative enhancements for new and existing campaigns, adapting copy, image sizes, destination URLs and language from existing ads and landing pages.

Enhanced versions can run without approval of every variation; existing account and campaign opt-outs are retained.

Campaign settings override account defaults and remain editable in Ads Manager. The original email report was published October 20.

When delivery can change copy and landing pages, brand review should cover source-page accuracy and campaign settings, especially promotions and product restrictions.

Confirm the enhancement choice for each account, inspect campaign overrides and update outdated prices, offers and availability.

This is an effective-date reminder, not a new October 30 announcement. Current official guidance says October 30; older reporting recorded conflicting dates. Individual account activation and causal performance effects were not tested.

items.title: Estée Lauder擴大Microsoft合作，以共用數據支撐美妝AI應用

items.title: Teads更新Ad Manager：跨屏投放已開放，AI及MCP仍限封閉測試
items.title_en: Teads updates Ad Manager: cross-screen performance is available, AI and MCP remain in closed beta
items.summary: Teads於10月29日公布新版Ad Manager，連結CTV與數位投放、全漏斗量度及AI工作流程，各項功能的開放階段並不相同。
items.summary_en: Teads announced its next Ad Manager October 29, connecting CTV and digital buying, full-funnel measurement and AI workflows, with different availability stages.
items.why: 代理商評估跨屏工具時，需要分清已能採購的投放功能與仍需申請的AI流程，避免把試行能力寫入交付承諾。
items.why_en: Agencies should distinguish purchasable media capabilities from gated AI workflows before including them in client delivery commitments.
items.next_step: 向Teads確認帳戶與測試資格，以一個跨屏活動核對版位、成本及量度資料能否接上現行報表。
items.next_step_en: Confirm account and beta eligibility, then map placements, costs and measurement from one cross-screen campaign into existing reports.
highlights: Unified Performance已向全球企業客戶開放，支援CTV與數位版位，並列出CAPI及GA4量度整合。

highlights_en: Unified Performance is generally available to global enterprise clients across CTV and digital placements, with CAPI and GA4 integrations described.
Full-Funnel Measurement, Strategy Builder, Control Hub and MCP integrations remain in closed beta for TAMbassadors; broader access is planned through year-end.
items.detail:
Teads於10月29日公布新版Ad Manager，連結CTV與數碼投放、全漏斗量度及AI工作流程，各項功能的開放階段並不相同。

Unified Performance已向全球企業客戶開放，支援CTV與數碼版位，並列出CAPI及GA4量度整合。

Full-Funnel Measurement、Strategy Builder、Control Hub及MCP整合仍限TAMbassadors封閉測試；較廣泛開放計劃於2026年底前推進。

代理商評估跨屏工具時，需要分清已能採購的投放功能與仍需申請的AI流程，避免把試行能力寫入交付承諾。

向Teads確認帳戶與測試資格，以一個跨屏活動核對版位、成本及量度資料能否接上現行報表。

公告中的排錯提速來自平台內部alpha測試，本刊不採作獨立效率結論；MCP並非所有客戶現時可用。
items.detail_en:
Teads announced its next Ad Manager October 29, connecting CTV and digital buying, full-funnel measurement and AI workflows, with different availability stages.

Unified Performance is generally available to global enterprise clients across CTV and digital placements, with CAPI and GA4 integrations described.

Full-Funnel Measurement, Strategy Builder, Control Hub and MCP integrations remain in closed beta for TAMbassadors; broader access is planned through year-end.

Agencies should distinguish purchasable media capabilities from gated AI workflows before including them in client delivery commitments.

Confirm account and beta eligibility, then map placements, costs and measurement from one cross-screen campaign into existing reports.

Troubleshooting-speed claims come from internal alpha tests and are not treated as independent efficiency evidence. MCP is not generally available.

items.title: Pika發布H3 Flex：開放權重與託管4K、分軌功能分開提供
items.title_en: Pika introduces H3 Flex, separating open weights from hosted finishing features
items.summary: Pika於10月29日發布基於MiniMax H3後訓練的H3 Flex，主打參考素材控制及音畫生成，並提供模型適配器與推論程式。
items.summary_en: Pika introduced H3 Flex October 29, a post-trained MiniMax H3 model for reference-controlled video and audio, with generator adapters and inference code released.
items.why: 創意團隊可比較品牌素材控制與後期交接，採購時亦要區分自行部署權重與託管服務的交付內容。
items.why_en: Creative teams can compare brand-reference control and editing handoffs while separating self-hosted model capabilities from hosted-service deliverables.
items.next_step: 以已獲授權產品相測試短鏡頭，逐格核對包裝、字體與人物，並確認分軌、升頻及模型授權條款。
items.next_step_en: Test a short shot with authorized product assets, inspect packaging, text and people frame by frame, and confirm stems, upscaling and license terms.
highlights: 官方列明可使用最多12份混合參考；原生影片為480p或768p，較高解像度由升頻完成。
4K升頻及五條音訊分軌是Pika託管功能；API路徑已提供，創作產品接入計劃為11月2日。
highlights_en: The announcement supports up to 12 mixed references; native video is 480p or 768p, with higher-resolution finishing through upscaling.
4K upscaling and five audio stems are hosted features. The API route is available; the creation-product rollout is planned for November 2.
items.detail:
Pika於10月29日發布基於MiniMax H3後訓練的H3 Flex，主打參考素材控制及音畫生成，並提供模型適配器與推論程式。

官方列明可使用最多12份混合參考；原生影片為480p或768p，較高解像度由升頻完成。

4K升頻及五條音訊分軌是Pika託管功能；API路徑已提供，創作產品接入計劃為11月2日。

創意團隊可比較品牌素材控制與後期交接，採購時亦要區分自行部署權重與託管服務的交付內容。

以已獲授權產品相測試短鏡頭，逐格核對包裝、字體與人物，並確認分軌、升頻及模型授權條款。

官方七秒數字只計受控測試中的模型運算，並非端到端交付時間；開放權重不代表所有託管功能或無條件商用授權。
items.detail_en:
Pika introduced H3 Flex October 29, a post-trained MiniMax H3 model for reference-controlled video and audio, with generator adapters and inference code released.

The announcement supports up to 12 mixed references; native video is 480p or 768p, with higher-resolution finishing through upscaling.

4K upscaling and five audio stems are hosted features. The API route is available; the creation-product rollout is planned for November 2.

Creative teams can compare brand-reference control and editing handoffs while separating self-hosted model capabilities from hosted-service deliverables.

Test a short shot with authorized product assets, inspect packaging, text and people frame by frame, and confirm stems, upscaling and license terms.

The seven-second claim measures model computation in a controlled benchmark, not end-to-end delivery. Open weights do not include every hosted feature or unrestricted commercial rights.

items.title: Marketbridge收購Channel99，推出B2B AI搜尋可見度服務
items.title_en: Marketbridge acquires Channel99 and introduces B2B AI Visibility
items.summary: Marketbridge於10月28日宣布收購B2B行銷量度平台Channel99，同時推出AI Visibility，協助品牌檢視AI答案中的呈現與競爭位置。
items.summary_en: Marketbridge announced its acquisition of B2B measurement platform Channel99 October 28 and introduced AI Visibility to assess brand presence and competitive positioning in AI answers.
items.why: B2B團隊可把AI可見度工具與實際執行服務一併評估，量度時要另分清提及、帳戶互動與銷售商機。
items.why_en: B2B teams can assess visibility tools alongside execution support, while keeping mentions, account engagement and pipeline as distinct measures.
items.next_step: 先固定買家問題、競品、語言及測量頻率，要求保留原始答案，再對照CRM商機而非直接宣稱歸因。
items.next_step_en: Fix buyer questions, competitors, languages and sampling frequency, retain original answers and compare CRM pipeline without assuming causation.
highlights: 方案結合Channel99的可見度分析、競爭情報與建議，以及Marketbridge的內容、網站、公關及策略服務。
Channel99將保留產品品牌，創辦人Chris Golec繼續領導，向Marketbridge行政總裁匯報。
highlights_en: The offering combines Channel99 visibility analysis, competitive intelligence and recommendations with Marketbridge content, web, PR and strategy services.
Channel99 retains its product identity, with founder Chris Golec continuing to lead and reporting to Marketbridge’s CEO.
items.detail:
Marketbridge於10月28日宣布收購B2B行銷量度平台Channel99，同時推出AI Visibility，協助品牌檢視AI答案中的呈現與競爭位置。

方案結合Channel99的可見度分析、競爭情報與建議，以及Marketbridge的內容、網站、公關及策略服務。

Channel99將保留產品品牌，創辦人Chris Golec繼續領導，向Marketbridge行政總裁匯報。

B2B團隊可把AI可見度工具與實際執行服務一併評估，量度時要另分清提及、帳戶互動與銷售商機。

先固定買家問題、競品、語言及測量頻率，要求保留原始答案，再對照CRM商機而非直接宣稱歸因。

公告未提供可獨立核實的增量銷售研究；本刊不採用其AI搜尋滲透率或訊號倍增數字作行業事實。
items.detail_en:
Marketbridge announced its acquisition of B2B measurement platform Channel99 October 28 and introduced AI Visibility to assess brand presence and competitive positioning in AI answers.

The offering combines Channel99 visibility analysis, competitive intelligence and recommendations with Marketbridge content, web, PR and strategy services.

Channel99 retains its product identity, with founder Chris Golec continuing to lead and reporting to Marketbridge’s CEO.

B2B teams can assess visibility tools alongside execution support, while keeping mentions, account engagement and pipeline as distinct measures.

Fix buyer questions, competitors, languages and sampling frequency, retain original answers and compare CRM pipeline without assuming causation.

The announcement does not establish independently measured incremental sales. Its AI-search adoption and signal-multiplier claims are excluded as industry facts.

items.title: Cognizant組建OpenAI交付團隊，先聚焦工程及客戶營運
items.title_en: Cognizant forms an OpenAI delivery group for engineering and customer operations
items.summary: Cognizant於10月30日宣布成立OpenAI Frontier Capability Group，集合逾25,000名專業人員，協助企業導入Codex、ChatGPT及相關系統。
items.summary_en: Cognizant announced the OpenAI Frontier Capability Group October 30, bringing together more than 25,000 professionals to deliver Codex, ChatGPT and related enterprise systems.
items.why: 對品牌與代理商，導入能力評估可由模型選型延伸至現有系統整合、營運責任及員工訓練。
items.why_en: Brands and agencies can extend supplier assessment beyond model choice to systems integration, operational accountability and workforce training.
items.next_step: 要求供應商以一項客戶服務或內容批准工序示範權限、人工覆核與失敗回退，再訂驗收標準。
items.next_step_en: Ask a supplier to demonstrate permissions, human review and fallback on one service or content-approval workflow before agreeing acceptance criteria.
highlights: 初期重點是AI原生軟體工程、應用程式現代化，以及代理式客戶營運。
公司表示自己的銷售與客戶成功團隊已使用基於OpenAI模型的方案，並把內部經驗帶入客戶交付。
highlights_en: Initial priorities are AI-native software engineering, application modernization and agentic customer operations.
The company says its sales and customer-success teams already use an OpenAI-based solution and will bring internal experience into client delivery.
items.detail:
Cognizant於10月30日宣布成立OpenAI Frontier Capability Group，集合逾25,000名專業人員，協助企業導入Codex、ChatGPT及相關系統。

初期重點是AI原生軟件工程、應用程式現代化，以及代理式客戶營運。

公司表示自己的銷售與客戶成功團隊已使用基於OpenAI模型的方案，並把內部經驗帶入客戶交付。

對品牌與代理商，導入能力評估可由模型選型延伸至現有系統整合、營運責任及員工訓練。

要求供應商以一項客戶服務或內容批准工序示範權限、人工覆核與失敗回退，再訂驗收標準。

25,000人是公司公布的組織配置，並非新增招聘數或全部已取得同一資格；個別客戶提效聲稱未經本刊獨立核實。
items.detail_en:
Cognizant announced the OpenAI Frontier Capability Group October 30, bringing together more than 25,000 professionals to deliver Codex, ChatGPT and related enterprise systems.

Initial priorities are AI-native software engineering, application modernization and agentic customer operations.

The company says its sales and customer-success teams already use an OpenAI-based solution and will bring internal experience into client delivery.

Brands and agencies can extend supplier assessment beyond model choice to systems integration, operational accountability and workforce training.

Ask a supplier to demonstrate permissions, human review and fallback on one service or content-approval workflow before agreeing acceptance criteria.

The 25,000 figure describes the announced delivery organization, not new hires or identical certification for every member. Client efficiency claims were not independently verified.

items.title: OpenAI擬支援共通AI訓練偏好訊號，現有爬蟲控制繼續有效
items.title_en: OpenAI plans support for a shared AI-training preference signal
items.summary: OpenAI於10月30日宣布，將尊重網站在robots.txt表達的共通基礎生成式AI訓練偏好訊號，目標是在未來數月實作。
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced October 30 that it will honor a shared robots.txt signal for foundational generative-AI training preferences, aiming to implement it in the coming months.
items.why: 品牌網站與內容出版團隊可把訓練偏好納入內容治理，並與搜尋可見度及其他用途的政策分開檢視。
items.why_en: Brand sites and publishers can include training preferences in content governance while separately reviewing search visibility and other uses.
items.next_step: 記錄現行爬蟲規則、網站內容權責與偏好，待官方公布實作細節後再交技術團隊評估變更。
items.next_step_en: Document crawler rules, content ownership and preferences, then assess changes when implementation details are published.
highlights: 參與供應商可接收同一偏好，減少網站逐個爬蟲維護規則的工作。
公司表示現有robots.txt爬蟲控制不會被取代；新訊號建基於IETF AI Preferences工作組的持續工作。
highlights_en: Participating providers can receive a common preference, reducing separate crawler-rule maintenance.
Existing robots.txt crawler controls remain in place; the initiative draws on ongoing IETF AI Preferences work.
items.detail:
OpenAI於10月30日宣布，將尊重網站在robots.txt表達的共通基礎生成式AI訓練偏好訊號，目標是在未來數月實作。

參與供應商可接收同一偏好，減少網站逐個爬蟲維護規則的工作。

公司表示現有robots.txt爬蟲控制不會被取代；新訊號建基於IETF AI Preferences工作組的持續工作。

品牌網站與內容出版團隊可把訓練偏好納入內容治理，並與搜尋可見度及其他用途的政策分開檢視。

記錄現行爬蟲規則、網站內容權責與偏好，待官方公布實作細節後再交技術團隊評估變更。

這是自願性參與及未來實作承諾，並非已部署完成、所有AI供應商均遵守，亦不構成內容權利或法律效力判定。
items.detail_en:
OpenAI announced October 30 that it will honor a shared robots.txt signal for foundational generative-AI training preferences, aiming to implement it in the coming months.

Participating providers can receive a common preference, reducing separate crawler-rule maintenance.

Existing robots.txt crawler controls remain in place; the initiative draws on ongoing IETF AI Preferences work.

Brand sites and publishers can include training preferences in content governance while separately reviewing search visibility and other uses.

Document crawler rules, content ownership and preferences, then assess changes when implementation details are published.

This is a voluntary initiative and implementation commitment, not completed deployment, universal provider compliance or a legal determination of content rights.

items.title: Liquid AI的LFM3走小型多模態路線，專項部署需另作評估
items.title_en: Liquid AI’s LFM3 targets specialized work with compact multimodal models
items.summary: Liquid AI於10月27日發布LFM3，首批為約20億參數級別的六款模型，涵蓋文字、視覺、音訊、全模態及決策用途。
items.summary_en: Liquid AI’s October 27 LFM3 release comprises six roughly two-billion-parameter-class models covering text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks.
items.why: 處理大量內容分類、素材檢查或客服分流的團隊，可評估專項小模型的部署取捨，仍需用實際語言與資料測試。
items.why_en: Teams handling content classification, asset checks or service routing can assess specialized small models against their own language and data requirements.
items.next_step: 交技術團隊選一項唯讀分類任務，用已匿名資料比較準確率、延遲、硬件成本與授權條款。
items.next_step_en: Have technical teams compare accuracy, latency, hardware costs and license terms on one read-only classification task using anonymized data.
highlights: 公司提供開放權重、Playground及API路徑，並主張可用自身資料微調與本地部署。
兩款決策模型處理結構化判斷；其輸出方式與撰寫長文的通用聊天模型有所區別。
highlights_en: The company provides open weights, Playground and API access, with local fine-tuning and deployment described.
Two decision models produce structured judgments, a different role from a general chatbot writing long-form responses.
items.detail:
Liquid AI於10月27日發布LFM3，首批為約20億參數級別的六款模型，涵蓋文字、視覺、音訊、全模態及決策用途。

公司提供開放權重、Playground及API路徑，並主張可用自身資料微調與本地部署。

兩款決策模型處理結構化判斷；其輸出方式與撰寫長文的通用聊天模型有所區別。

處理大量內容分類、素材檢查或客服分流的團隊，可評估專項小模型的部署取捨，仍需用實際語言與資料測試。

交技術團隊選一項唯讀分類任務，用已匿名資料比較準確率、延遲、硬件成本與授權條款。

本則保留10月27日原始發布日期；供應商基準及所有裝置皆可運行等概括聲稱不作本刊實測結論，亦不推定粵語品質。
items.detail_en:
Liquid AI’s October 27 LFM3 release comprises six roughly two-billion-parameter-class models covering text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks.

The company provides open weights, Playground and API access, with local fine-tuning and deployment described.

Two decision models produce structured judgments, a different role from a general chatbot writing long-form responses.

Teams handling content classification, asset checks or service routing can assess specialized small models against their own language and data requirements.

Have technical teams compare accuracy, latency, hardware costs and license terms on one read-only classification task using anonymized data.

This item retains the October 27 release date. Vendor benchmarks and broad device claims are not independent tests, and Cantonese quality is not assumed.
